title: Visual Studio Code and autodiscovery of MCP servers: better to stay in control.
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: each MCP consumes token just for describing what is does, so IMO it's better to have a clean configuration
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the performance impact of having unnecessary MCP servers installed and configured

quotes.text: Microsoft Visual Studio Code Team is thinking to set the autodiscovery feature of MCP servers to DISABLE by default in future versions
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates Microsoft recognizes the issue and plans to change the default behavior
